therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: adults with type 2 diabetes on stable insulin therapy with or without metformin
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: adjusted mean change from baseline in HbA1c at week 24 (LOCF)

results.effect_size: -0.41% HbA1c difference (saxagliptin vs placebo; 95% CI: -0.59 to -0.24)
biomarker_changes: PPG AUC change: -4548.5 mg*min/dL (saxagliptin) vs -718.8 (placebo); difference -3829.8 (p=0.0011)
Fasting plasma glucose change: -10.1 mg/dL (saxagliptin) vs -6.1 (placebo); difference -4.02 (p=0.3958, NS)
Mean total daily insulin dose change: +1.71 units (saxagliptin) vs +5.01 units (placebo); difference -3.3 units (p not fully reported)
17.3% of saxagliptin patients achieved A1C <7% vs 6.7% placebo
subgroup_findings: Lymphocyte counts remained stable in both arms across weeks 24 and 52
Platelet counts remained stable in both arms across weeks 24 and 52
Confirmed hypoglycemia (glucose ≤50 mg/dL with symptoms): 7.6% saxagliptin vs 6.6% placebo
safety_signals: 2 deaths in saxagliptin arm vs 0 in placebo arm

Cardiac SAEs in saxagliptin arm: cardiac failure (2), myocardial infarction (1), acute myocardial infarction (1), acute coronary syndrome (1), coronary artery occlusion (1), myocardial ischaemia (1), angina pectoris (1)
25 SAEs in saxagliptin arm vs 13 in placebo arm
3 treatment-related SAEs in saxagliptin arm vs 0 in placebo
9 discontinuations due to AEs in saxagliptin arm vs 3 in placebo
Marked lab abnormalities: ALT >3×ULN in 5 saxagliptin vs 3 placebo; AST >3×ULN in 2 saxagliptin vs 0 placebo
Urinary blood marked abnormality: 14 saxagliptin vs 2 placebo
White blood cells urine marked abnormality: 35 saxagliptin vs 10 placebo

dose_info.dose_modifications: flexible insulin dose adjustment as needed for rescue

adverse_events.term: White blood cells urine marked abnormality

context.comparator: placebo plus insulin (with or without metformin)

modulation_entries.hypothesis: DPP-4 inhibition by saxagliptin prolongs active GLP-1/GIP, augmenting glucose-dependent insulin secretion and reducing postprandial glucose excursions on top of exogenous insulin, thereby amplifying the overall glycemic control biology of insulin therapy
modulation_entries.citation: Adjusted Mean Change From Baseline in A1C Levels: saxagliptin -0.73 vs placebo -0.32; Mean Difference -0.41 (95% CI: -0.59–-0.24), p<0.0001
